test_tty_existence_check_regression: test that install.sh functions do not use bare existence-only checks on /dev/tty before redirecting stdin
test_tty_open_based_probe: test that install.sh functions use an open-based probe of /dev/tty instead of a mere existence check
extract_shell_function_body: extract the body of a named shell function from scripts/install.sh using regex pattern matching
test_run_setup_wizard_tty_gate: test the run_setup_wizard function in install.sh gates on an open-based /dev/tty probe not existence
test_install_system_packages_tty_gate: test the install_system_packages function in install.sh uses open-based /dev/tty probing for the apt sudo prompt
